---
title: "APOE and Dementia Association"
---

## Overview

Examine APOE genotype distribution and its association with dementia trajectory.

ApoE Genotypes and Dementia Risk:

- e2/e2 (22): Generally protective against Alzheimer's disease.
- e2/e3 (23): Slightly protective effect.
- e2/e4 (24): Mixed effect; e2 is protective while e4 increases risk.
- e3/e3 (33): Most common genotype; considered neutral for Alzheimer's risk.
- e3/e4 (34): Moderately increased risk of Alzheimer's disease.
- e4/e4 (44): Highest risk for Alzheimer's disease among these genotypes.

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

pacman::p_load(gt, gtsummary, infer, install = FALSE)

conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
```

## Load data

Load UMAP embeddings and join APOE genotype from the SAS genotype file.

```{r}
umap_embed <- read_rds(here("UMAP/lite/output/embedding_threshold_8.rds"))

apoe_geno <-
  haven::read_sas(here("data/private/apoe_genotype.sas7bdat")) |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(genoapoe = factor(genoapoe, levels = c("22", "23", "33", "24", "34", "44")))

um <-
  umap_embed |>
  left_join(apoe_geno, by = c("subject_id" = "subr_id18"))

glimpse(um)
```

## Count

APOE genotype counts.

```{r}
um |>
  count(genoapoe) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(columns = n, decimals = 0)
```

## APOE and Dementia

### Chi-square test

```{r}
chisq_result <-
  um |>
  infer::chisq_test(genoapoe ~ demcat, correct = TRUE)

chisq_result
```

### Cross-tabulation table

```{r}
format_pvalue <- function(p) {
  exponent <- floor(log10(p))
  significand <- p / 10^exponent
  sprintf("%.2f x 10<sup>%d</sup>", significand, exponent)
}

apoe_dem_table <-
  um |>
  filter(!is.na(genoapoe)) |>
  tbl_cross(
    genoapoe, demcat,
    percent = "row",
    label = list(genoapoe = "APOE genotype", demcat = "Dementia transition")
  ) |>
  bold_labels() |>
  as_gt() |>
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = glue("Chi-square test: <i>P</i> = {format_pvalue(chisq_result$p_value)}") |> html()
  )

apoe_dem_table
```

### Save the table

```{r}
fs::dir_create(here("APOE/output"))

apoe_dem_table |>
  write_rds(file = here("APOE/output/apoe_dementia_cross_table.rds")) |>
  gtsave(file = here("APOE/output/apoe_dementia_cross_table.png"), expand = 10, vwidth = 1600, vheight = 1200, zoom = 2)
```
